idea-plugin.name: Antigravity Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Bridges the Antigravity CLI (agy) with PhpStorm so the agent can see your active file, selection, open tabs, and inspection diagnostics on demand.

The plugin runs a small local MCP (Model Context Protocol) server inside the IDE and registers itself in ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json. Whenever agy needs editor context it calls the plugin over MCP — no env vars, no lockfiles, no platform-specific bridges.

Click the Start Antigravity Session toolbar button (top-right) to launch agy in an IDE-embedded terminal pre-wired to the running project.

Exposed tools

  • ide_get_active_editor — current file path, language, cursor, selection, content.
  • ide_get_open_files — every file currently open in an editor tab.
  • ide_get_diagnostics — inspections/errors/warnings for a file.
  • ide_open_file — open a file at an optional line/column.

Configure the path to your agy binary under Settings → Tools → Antigravity Companion.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.1

  • Replaced the deprecated TerminalToolWindowManager.createLocalShellWidget(...) call with the non-deprecated createNewSession(runner, TerminalTabState) path — clears the "scheduled for removal" compatibility warning on newer IDEs.
  • Replaced the deprecated 4-arg TextFieldWithBrowseButton.addBrowseFolderListener(...) in the settings panel with the modern TextBrowseFolderListener form.
  • agy now runs as the terminal tab's process directly instead of being typed into a shell; the tab closes cleanly when the user exits agy.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Local MCP server with four tools: ide_get_active_editor, ide_get_open_files, ide_get_diagnostics, ide_open_file.
  • Cross-platform stdio bridge using the IDE's bundled JBR (macOS, Linux, Windows).
  • Settings panel under Tools → Antigravity Companion for the agy binary path; auto-detects $PATH, ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin when blank.
